title: Pumpkins Reforged
body:
**This pack completely reimagines pumpkins giving them brand new models with stems and vines! Regular pumpkins have 3 variants, while carved pumpkins now have 10+ expression variants from spooky to downright goofy :D**

![pumpkins](https://i.gyazo.com/e55d619d5da5cfc8612d63211428deb6.png)

The contents of this mini pack are from a greater project I'm working on called [Rappenem's Reforge](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rappenems-reforge) which aims to resprite the whole game in this style. So if you like the pixel art on display here consider checking it out and supporting me on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/Rappenem) for early access as well as bonus content!

[![FF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe2313e6ca2c3df47d179aa09bbc4c57799f6094.png)](https://www.patreon.com/Rappenem)
[![D](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95be1badf0f5131587308606c53801d55223882c.png)](https://discord.com/invite/2hvKFfPzQt)[![F](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77276c296d994e962ff04b57a57206c7abf516de.png)](https://www.instagram.com/rappenems_reforge/)[![H](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24c2ce58d5be6a91a8fb4e14aee09b885f105ad5.png)](https://x.com/Rapps_Reforge)

### Spice up your builds with these 13 unique pumpkin faces variants!

![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/45a649e07c9662998699867d73448dfa.png)
![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/b310a83f97db3e8adaa1db8d49c240d2.png)
![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/10ce41c950338afbc0e2e0d6cc9c0aa4.png)

### Enjoy more vibrant jack-o-lanterns thanks to the addition of emissives

![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/1f044f11a863847c3e217ce0f8e4e9a8.png)

### 3 unique pumpkin models to add variation to the patch!

![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/118abe2988e3cbebd3dbc12fbf3f48ca.png)

### Additional notes:

- The face variants are not truly "random" given how Minecraft's code actually works. Upon world generation each block is associated to a variant meaning that while giving the illusion of randomness, breaking and replacing a pumpkin in the same spot will always generate the same variant.
  
- Features that make the pumpkin models showcased in these screenshots like transparency and multi-axis rotations are only possible in newer versions of the game (1.21.11+) meaning if you're playing in older versions you might notice that things like the vines and emissive jack-o-lanterns are missing. This is perfectly normal and the only way to achieve compatibility with older versions!
